tool_input.command:
git add internal/testserver/imap.go && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(testserver): commit source mutation before returning on Move expunge error (M6)

A mid-loop return on a WriteExpunge error left a message appended to
the destination mailbox but never removed from the source, since
s.selected.messages = remaining only ran after the loop completed.
Aggregate the first expunge error instead of returning early, so the
source mailbox mutation always completes before Move returns.

Not independently unit-tested: imapserver.MoveWriter is a sealed
concrete type tied to a real network Conn (unexported field, no
exported constructor), so there's no supported way to inject a
WriteExpunge failure from outside the imapserver package. Verified by
full build, vet, gosec, and the existing email/testserver suites,
which already exercise Move's success path end to end.
EOF
)"
